कौतुक n. (-कं)
 1. Eagerness, vehemence, impatience.
 2. Joy, pleasure,
happiness.
 3. Sport, pastime.
 4. A festivity.
 5. Wish, inclination.
6.

. Kind or friendly greeting, civility, salutation.
 8.
The marriage thread or ring.
 9. The enjoyment of public diver-
sions.
 10. Song, dance, show or spectacle.
 11. Season of enjoyment.
E. कुतुक, and अण् aff.

कौतूहल n. (-लं)
 1. Eagerness, vehemence.
 2. Curiosity.
 E. कुतूहल and
अण् pleonastic affix; also with ष्यञ् affix, कौतूहल्य n. (-ल्यं.)

कौतूहलान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Eager, vehement.
 2. Curious.
 E. कौतूहल,
and अन्वित having.
